collection_howto.reference_engine: PerfectManseryeok on repo main (scripts/manseryeok_perfect_final.py); native pillars must match python scripts/validate_collision_dictionary_v1.py
steps: After any change to scripts/manseryeok_perfect_final.py, run: python scripts/collision_dict_refresh_native_v1.py --write
In the target app (e.g. Postella), enter the same birth local date/time as implied by birth_instant_utc + Asia/Seoul unless you document another IANA tz in location_note.
Copy the four pillars (yeon, wol, il, si) into pillars_external using the same Hangul spelling as native.
Set upstream_fingerprint.app, .version (app build or settings string), .sampled_utc (ISO Z when you captured the screenshot), and .device_tz if not Seoul.
Set policy_resolution: native if you adopt repo engine; external if product policy follows the app; unresolved if still deciding.
Run python scripts/validate_collision_dictionary_v1.py — native checksum must pass; external lines are informational.
